t: Display shows only a big UPDATE and the new version while an online update is loading; after the restart as usual
All lights (LEDs and high beam) go off while an online update is loading
FC tab (Channels live, Connection to FC): only one column, also on a wide screen
High beam is always off after power-on or an update (it no longer comes back at the last level)
Wi-Fi: tap one of your own access points in Networks around the Core to switch to exactly that one

Display: last German words replaced – tiles now show on / off / ready instead of an / aus / bereit
Display → Layout: new Big values – 1 to 3 values as big as possible (choose them in the Big values card)
Web page: Core IP address shown at the top next to Mojave
Display tile Battery shows only the cell voltage (bigger)
New display tile Battery % (choose it in Display → Tiles, e.g. instead of Used mAh)
